title: Touchscreen and touch-button usability
summary: Feedback on the G60's touch-based controls is split between appreciation for the touch-button design and concerns or uncertainty about usability versus physical buttons.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the touch buttons on the interaction bar, though examples are limited.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says some functions must be operated only through touch controls, which is disappointing.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback describes ongoing adjustment to the touchscreens and difficulty locating touch controls without tactile cues or in low light.

limitations: The topic has very few reviews, so examples are limited.
One positive-assigned review also contains a fragment describing hard-to-manage touch buttons without haptic feedback, which complicates interpretation at the review level.
The sample is stratified and not representative, so it should not be used to infer broader prevalence or defect rates.
